info.title: SwitchPoint API
info.description: FCA-compliant pension switching, DB transfer and cashflow analysis for UK IFAs. Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login and send 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

post.summary: Exchanges email and password for a bearer token.
Renders a report from a calculated analysis and locks the analysis.

get.summary: Re-walks the firm's hash chain and reports the first broken link, if any.

AdviserChargeBasis.description: Basis on which the adviser is paid for DB transfer advice (COBS 19.1B).

AssumptionOverrides.description: Adviser overrides applied on top of an assumption set for one calculation (captured for audit).

CedingSchemeRef.description: A ceding scheme reference: either a stored scheme id or an inline definition.

FixedChargeScope.description: Which part of a product a FixedCharge attaches to.

Frequency.description: How often a payment (contribution or fixed charge) is made. Frequency.Single is a one-off.

FundChargeBasisKind.description: Where the fund-level ongoing charge comes from.

IndexationBasis.description: How a fixed monetary charge grows over time.

IndexBasis.description: Index a DB benefit is linked to in deferment or in payment.

clientAge.description: Client age used when no client id is given (inline schemes); default 55.

SchemeType.description: The kind of existing arrangement a client holds.

SwitchVerdict.description: Verdict for a single ceding scheme, mapped to the FSA 2009 switching template outcomes.

TaxRegime.description: Which income tax regime applies to the client's non-savings income.

TieredChargeMode.description: How the bands of a TieredCharge are applied to a fund value.

UserRole.description: Roles carried as claims on every authenticated user.
